title: Casting data types (Memphis)
description: The code below demonstrates how to swap the values of x and y, and perform some casting operations to convert variables from one data type into another

lines.explanation: Declares two int variables named x and y, and assigns them values of 4 and 10, respectively
This line does *not* mean that x and y are always the same!  It simply says "store the value of y into the variable x, once"
This line changes y into 8, but x is unaffected
Create a new variable named temp to store the old value of x
Replace x with the value of y
Replace y with the value of temp (which is the old value of x)
